newsitem.title: USA: Life Medical Sciences granted U.S. patent.
newsitem.headline: Life Medical Sciences granted U.S. patent.

text.p: Life Medical Sciences Inc said on Wednesday that it has received an additional U.S. patent covering the use of its bioresorbable polymer technology for post-operative adhesion prevention.

The company is developing a series of products based on this technology which address the largely unmet challenge of preventing adhesion (scar tissue) formation which can cause serious complications after surgery, Life Medical said in a statement.

Life Medical Sciences' first adhesion prevention product, REPEL bioresorbable adhesion barrier film, is currently in multi-center clinical trials for gynecological surgery in the United States and Europe, the company said.
